title: Hepatitis B routine 3-dose infant series completed by age 2
action: Administer a 3-dose HepB series at age 0, 1-2, and 6-18 months

derived.min: final dose is due by 18 months, so children turning 2 in the measurement year should have completed the series
derived.max: single-year cohort of children turning 2 in the measurement year

derived.window: children age 2 at end of MY were born in MY-2; series starts at birth so window runs from earliest possible birth date through end of MY

numerator.note: cannot enforce dose timing, minimum intervals, or minimum age 24 weeks for final dose
